items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Parks Wilkes played over on the Gulf Coast with Ellis Stratikas.

ctx.x: Oh, yes it was. Then? Yes. As far as... If anyone was ever caught, I don't know of anybody ever going to jail with it on account of it. But all you had to do was go down to St. Philip Street and knock on the wall and stick your finger in the hole for the... and 20 cents was all you could afford in those days. So it was... The first piano job that I had when I left Mobile and came to New Orleans was at the Silver Slipper and that was with a little small push-around piano, short keyboard about that big and I…

Buck Rogers played drums. Red, I can't remember his last name from Biloxi, played sax. Not Parks Wilkes now, Parks Wilkes played over on the Gulf Coast with Ellis Stratikas. That was where I first knew Ellis Stratikas was on the coast. That was before Ellis Stratikas came to New Orleans to play.
When did you come to New Orleans first?
